title: Finding
description: Evidence that a control is not holding. Input to a risk assessment. NEVER a risk, never a register row. Links to the control it tests. SLA-bound only when it is a vulnerability AND exploitable.

kind.description: A vulnerability is an exploitable weakness. The rest are findings but not vulnerabilities.

tests_control.description: The control this finding tests. Required. The risk is the harm that control exists to prevent.

exploitable.description: Only a vulnerability that is exploitable is SLA-bound; findings are not.

exploit_basis.description: Why exploitable: reachable from where, by whom, needing what. Required when exploitable = yes.

provenance_class.description: oDeshi provenance-driven severity. Hard = backed by two stakeholders or a domain authority; earns the right to block.

sla.description: Present ONLY when kind=vulnerability AND exploitable=yes.

signal_route.description: Where this finding was routed: a control re-test, a decision re-open, a task. Never the register.

source.description: The producing scan, test, auditor, or monitor. No source, no fact.

closed_state_change.description: What changed in the thing measured, when closed. A finding re-opening with no state change is the 'staged green' sensor.
